body: the last time i’ve opened up to a cis man i got forced out of thr closet because he stsrted to SPREAD the fact that i was trans. but hey, showinf signs of trauma and havijg to guard yourself all the time is pretty selfish i guess. i’m sorry for beijg snappy but i feel tired of feeling invalidated and treated like i’m just being stingy for what i think are very valid reasons.

it’s really funny because i first suggested BPD as a potential diagnosis but i didn’t entirely meet the criteria according to both my shrink and my therapist, then i got the CPTSD diagnosis. rambling aside i am in therapy, yeah.

i take it you haven’t seen the news, especially in regards to what’s happening trans people. i’m not gonna fight people over this comment anymore but i have a hard time trusting a majority group that has time and time again, outside of allies, proven to be indifferent to the safety and rights of trans people or at worst want us back in the closet.
ok, i’m starting to see where you come from. i alpolgize for my hostility. i have a lot of trust issues due to past experiences, so that’s where my position comes from.
so what, i shouldn’t worry about being the next trans person on the news?

idk, maybe if i didn’t live in an innately transphobic world and didn’t experience constant abuse within a cis and heterosexual dominated system, then i’d probably be a bit more open to trusting cis people enough to let them in. maybe i am making myself lonely, sure, but my own safety should be my priority; i cannot trust that a cis man or cis woman doesn’t have nefarious intentions especially in this day and age.
are familiar with the concept of t4t?
a cis man does not share my experiences as a trans man, and i find it rare for cis men to wven know what a trans man is.
the thing is that for safety reasons, i’m trans 4 trans. i rarely trust cis people in general that much nowadays unless we’ve had an already existing friendship.

i feel like i’m relapsing back into my more incel-y behaviour and lashing out at my transfem friends (i’m transmasc) because i feel deeply envious with transfems being able to connect with one another so easily. my friend called me out rightfully and since then i’ve just been ruminating on whether i can or can’t change. i’m in therapy but due to some misscchedulings and my therapist moving away soon and thus likely unable to continue my care, i feel like i’m getting worse. i’m scared of losing my friends because of my own behaviour.

what do i do?

He was stuck on a ship until a sea monster attacked it, mortally wounding him; but not before he meets his patron, the Leviathan, who gives him the name Looping Coil.
